description: Taxonomy of math-ESTIMATOR / guard / formula surfaces whose correctness depends on the INTENDED model (whitepaper/invariant), not on NatSpec/code agreement. Drives math_estimator_audit.py and validate_math_estimator_clears.py via math_estimator_taxonomy.classify(). Motivated by the QuantAMM strict-eval H-11 MISS: the covariance estimator was strong-cleared because 'formulas match NatSpec', yet the implementation deviated from the intended estimator. A clear of these surfaces requires an independent formula re-derivation (math_estimator_proof), not a consistency check.
_fp_note: TWO-SIGNAL RULE is the FP backbone: math_estimator_sensitive only when a DOMAIN term (covariance/variance/gradient/momentum/moving-average/normalization/guard-rail/epsilon/clamp/interpolation/estimator/oracle-math/fee-math/price-math/invariant) co-occurs with a STRUCTURAL SIGNAL (a loop, matrix/vector [i][j] indexing, PRBMath .mul/.div/.pow/.log2/.exp2, a scale constant 1e9/1e18/1e36, bit-shift packing, or a clamp/min/max) UNLESS an UNAMBIGUOUS token fires (_guardQuantAMMWeights, _calculateQuantAMM*, pow/log2/exp2 on signed fixed point). Lone constants, single +/- arithmetic, plain balance/transfer math, and pure getters are NOT tagged.

covariance.review_hint: Covariance estimator A(t)=lambda*A(t-1)+(p-mavg(t-1))(p-mavg(t))'. RE-DERIVE the (1-lambda) placement, the outer-product u_i*v_j scaling, and the diagonal vs off-diagonal terms against the whitepaper — NatSpec matching code is NOT proof (QuantAMM H-11).

variance.review_hint: Variance estimator and any 1/variance use. RE-DERIVE the (1-lambda)A(t) scaling, confirm variance cannot go negative or zero into a reciprocal, and check the negative-weight guard on BOTH branches.

gradient.review_hint: Gradient/momentum recurrence a(t)=lambda*a(t-1)+(p-mavg)/(1-lambda) and the mulFactor. RE-DERIVE the sign/direction and the packed-state storage INDEX (storageArrayIndex vs asset index) — the QuantAMM vector-lambda branch wrote OOB.

moving_average.review_hint: EWMA mavg(t)=mavg(t-1)+(1-lambda)(p(t)-mavg(t-1)). RE-DERIVE the (1-lambda) factor and the prev-vs-current buffer indexing.

normalization.review_hint: Weight normalization to sum==1e18. RE-DERIVE that the rescale/remainder logic preserves the sum AND keeps every weight within the rails for the min-clamp-only and max-clamp paths — not just that it 'looks consistent'.

guard_rail.review_hint: Guard-rail clamp + epsilon speed-limit. RE-DERIVE that clamping a subset still renormalizes to sum==1 and respects [absoluteMin, absoluteMax]; 'the guard clamps the output' is NOT a proof of correctness of the guard itself.

interpolation.review_hint: Per-block weight interpolation/multiplier. RE-DERIVE the multiplier=(delta)/interval scaling, the 9dp pack truncation (multiplier->0), and the lastInterpolationTime freeze boundary.

oracle_math.review_hint: Oracle scaling/aggregation math (decimal normalization, multi-hop inversion, staleness fallback control-flow). RE-DERIVE the scaling and the fallback branch selection; in-spec-data MISHANDLING is in scope.

fee_math.review_hint: Fee/uplift math (ratio, split, percentage). RE-DERIVE the scaling of feePerLP/feePercentage and the admin/owner split division; integer-division truncation can zero or invert the fee.

price_math.review_hint: Price/valuation math (sum of price*balance / supply). RE-DERIVE the scaling and whether the quantity is conserved under the relevant operation (linear sum vs invariant).

other.review_hint: Math-heavy estimator/guard/formula. RE-DERIVE the intended formula independently and check edge cases; do not clear on NatSpec/code agreement.
